items.name: base
items.title: Base
items.description: Tokens, the animated glow/breathe custom properties, the shared keyframes, and small helpers (cx, mergeRefs, useGlowDelay). Every other item depends on it.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: The site's voice: one monospace stack, everything lower case, with a .keep-case escape hatch. Import kneuroth-type.css once from the app entry or root layout.

items.name: glow-sweep
items.title: Sweep link
items.description: The canonical text link: letters breathing white to blue, one cube-colour sweep across them on hover. SweepLink, the useGlowSweep hook, and the .glow-sweep class.

items.name: glow-button
items.title: Glow button
items.description: A control that reads as a word: embossed letters with a revolving cube-colour ring behind them. Variants warm, dark, azure (by surface) and icon (for every icon-only control); sweep for text link-buttons.

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass material
items.description: The frosted-glass material as classes: .glass-edge (the breathing white-to-blue stroke and bloom) and .glass-dark (the near-black inward fill), plus GlassPanel's styles.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: Glass panel
items.description: Every frosted surface: a floating rounded panel with a layered edge (stroke, clear strip, frost), a header bar, or a dark footer bar. edge joins a floating panel to a screen edge.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass button
items.description: A control that reads as an object: a pressable slab of the panel's glass with the cube-colour triad revolving on its rim. Tones light and dark, picked from the ground.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search box on the panel's glass: the quietest edge, a pale-blue magnifier, and a held blue stroke while focused. Controlled or uncontrolled; Escape clears.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Flies content in from the side of the screen the first time it scrolls into view, once. Reveal (a wrapper that is observed and never moves) and the useReveal hook.

items.name: all
items.title: Everything
items.description: Every kneuroth-ui item in one install.
